'''Shuttle 201-7''' was the designation of a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]]. At some point, it was [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and used on a [[Hijacking of Freighter M226|mission]] to [[Martle Station]].<ref name="PH" />
